definition: This is the reported profit for Subros after costs and tax, including its share of profit from the Denso Subros engineering joint venture.
sourceLabel: Audited annual results filed with NSE
location: Audited consolidated statement, year ended March 31, 2026, rows I, V and X, and notes 4–6.
notes: Other income includes ₹14.78 crore from a Gujarat government grant. A separate ₹8.08 crore charge for employee benefits under new labour rules reduced profit before tax. Subros reports one segment, so the filing gives no profit split by cooling product or vehicle maker.
insight: Sales and profit grew from the previous year. Use costs and profit together to see how much of the extra sales remained after paying for materials, wages and other expenses.
